title: daphne odora subsp. acutiloba
intro: Daphne odora subsp. acutiloba, commonly known as Japanese spurge or Japanese daphne, is a plant species belonging to the genus Daphne and family Thymelaeaceae. It is known for its medicinal and aromatic properties, and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Daphne odora subsp. acutiloba include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including bronchodilation and antimicrobial activity.
